Thomas]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsWY}} The '''1994 United States Senate election in Wyoming''' was held November 3, 1994. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator [[Malcolm Wallop]] decided to retire instead of seeking a fourth term. Republican U.S. Representative [[Craig L. Thomas]] won the open seat, defeating Democratic Governor [[Mike Sullivan (governor)|Mike Sullivan]]. == Major candidates == === Democratic === * [[Mike Sullivan (governor)|Mike Sullivan]], [[List of governors of Wyoming|Governor of Wyoming]] === Republican === * [[Craig L.
